$comment: Single source of truth for per-route metadata. Consumed at runtime by src/config/routeMeta.ts (pages call usePageMeta) and at build time by scripts/prerender.mjs, which writes one static HTML file per route and regenerates public/sitemap.xml. Keep the policy paths in sync with src/lib/policyPages.ts.
